most_similar_reason: Candidate 8 shares the core plot exactly: a divinely warned man builds a vessel to survive a god-sent flood punishing human wickedness, lands on a mountain, gives thanks/sacrifice, and then repopulates the earth as ancestor of peoples.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 6 has no flood, no divine command or covenant, and no ancestral repopulation—only a smith's captivity and grisly revenge, sharing nothing distinctive with the target.
